hypothesis_contract.null: Aggregating same-pair/same-direction V25 signals into one bounded inventory episode does not produce positive RAW walk-forward equity or does not make both full comparable months reach 2.0x under both normal and adverse costs.
hypothesis_contract.alternative: One bounded no-add basket-hold rule preserves all 500 V25 RAW signals while reducing ticket turnover enough for both full comparable months to reach at least 2.0x under both normal and adverse costs without changing leverage, period, signal direction, or holdout state.

training_only_rule_selection.selection_basis: The generated V28 work order named one causal basket-hold rule. The first candidate was accepted structurally because it aggregates repeated same-direction narratives without adding units and has a deterministic opposite, expiry, and terminal state machine.

execution_rule.name: CAUSAL_BASKET_HOLD_NO_ADD
execution_rule.state_scope: one independent inventory state per pair
execution_rule.units: one fixed 1/7 NAV sleeve per pair; no unit increase
execution_rule.chronology: Sort completed source bars by exact integer epoch nanoseconds. At each completed executable bar: close inventory whose 48-hour target has elapsed at the current open; then apply any V25 signal at that same open; then mark remaining inventory at completed close.
execution_rule.opposite_direction_signal: Close the existing sleeve at that signal's executable open and open one reverse fixed 1/7 sleeve at the same open.
execution_rule.target_hold_unit: elapsed UTC seconds from episode entry
execution_rule.missing_target_bar: Use the first completed executable open at or after the 48-hour target; this depends on timestamp availability only, never price or outcome.
execution_rule.hard_max_age_rationale: Four UTC days is a finite safety ceiling that covers one known closed-market weekend around the single 48-hour target without outcome-based tuning.
execution_rule.terminal_liquidation: Close every remaining sleeve at the last completed bar close of each evaluation period and realize the terminal MTM.
execution_rule.inventory_use: Repeated same-direction RAW signals are narrative evidence attached to the existing episode; they never create another ticket or add exposure.

cost_arm_contract.raw_price: mid open/close with no spread, slippage, commission, or financing
cost_arm_contract.base_price: frozen V7 executable BID/ASK, slippage, commission, and financing
cost_arm_contract.adverse_price: frozen V7 adverse BID/ASK, slippage, commission, and financing

rejection_contract.system_fail: Any frozen hash, RAW identity, completed chronology, arm-transition parity, source, inventory cap, finite max-age, terminal liquidation, MTM, authority, holdout, evaluation-period, leverage, or threshold mismatch fails before or after execution.
rejection_contract.profit_reject: Automatically reject if either full comparable month is below 2.0x in EXECUTABLE_BASE or ADVERSE_STRESS, or unopened holdout reproduction is absent.
rejection_contract.raw_edge_reason: BASKET_HOLD_RAW_EDGE_ABSENT when walk-forward RAW equity is at or below 1.0.
